criteria.description: Correctness on standard positive inputs: returns correct GCD for docstring examples greatest_common_divisor(3,5)==1 and (25,15)==5, and other typical pairs like (12,8)==4, (100,10)==10, (7,7)==7.

Edge-case handling for zero and negatives per standard math definition: gcd(0,b)==abs(b), gcd(a,0)==abs(a), gcd(0,0)==0, and gcd(-a,b)==gcd(a,-b)==abs(gcd(a,b)) >=0. No crash or non-termination on these.

Termination, type and syntactic validity: body is indented to fit under def, is valid Python, always returns an int (not None/str), terminates quickly on large values (e.g., 10**12) without infinite loop, recursion depth error, or exception on any int pair.
